description: Na₂BSnAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.77 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.32-1.45 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.13 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-51°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.75 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Sn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Sn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sn and one As atom.
